lines.t: Shabbat Shalom, hey — peace flows like a river,
Feel the light stay, let it shine forever!
Why do you depart when sundown falls?
Chasing the noise of the city walls?
Close your door, but your heart swings wide,
The world rushes in with the morning tide.
But what if this peace could stay?
What if we could live this way?
Treat every day as the Sabbath, my friend,
Let the love and stillness never end.
Keep the light that Shabbat brings to your heart,
Carry it with you, don’t let it depart.
The candles flicker, the wine runs deep,
But the spirit’s joy is ours to keep.
From sunset glow to morning new,
Let the Sabbath live in all you do.
Hear the song through the days ahead,
Let that peace be your daily bread.
Treat every day as the Sabbath, my friend,
Let the love and stillness never end.
Keep the light that Shabbat brings to your heart,
Carry it with you, don’t let it depart.
Six days may spin and the hours may fly,
But hold that calm in your heart inside.
Every moment, every breath you take,
Let it honor the rest you make.
Treat every day as the Sabbath, my friend,
Let the circle of peace transcend.
Keep the flame that the Sabbath starts,
Light up the world with a thousand hearts.
Shabbat Shalom — every day anew,
The Sabbath lives inside of you.
